item.title: ssh
item.description:
ssh

ssh friend@hostname

sshfs

This should be enough :

sshfs friend@hostname:/ ~/mnt
fusermount -u ~/mnt

This is a more complete and reliable command :

➜ ~ sshfs -o reconnect,ServerAliveInterval=15,ServerAliveCountMax=3,allow_other,default_permissions ambre@192.168.1.193:/ citron

This version adds :

  • auto-reconnect
  • keepalive a long idle connection
  • other users can see the mount
  • permission checks are sure to fully reflect remove behavior

curlfttpfs

No interests if ssh is available.

item.title: git
item.description:
git pull overwrite local changes

git reset --hard
git pull

Undo the last commit

git reset HEAD^

replace local branch with remote branch entirely

git reset --hard origin/main

Se connecter en SSH

How to get and configure your Git and github SSH Keys

Pour se connecter en SSH il faut:

  1. avoir une clé SSH
  2. copier cette clé sur le remote

check existing key

ls -la ~/.ssh

create Key

ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C your@email.com
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa

Copy public SSH Key

cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub

Then add the public Key on github or gitlab account.
